name: What is the typical timeline for constructing a custom luxury home?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for constructing a custom luxury home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom luxury home varies significantly based on design complexity, material selections, site conditions, and permitting processes. Generally, the design phase can take 3-6 months, while construction can range from 12-24 months or longer. Factors like custom cabinetry, intricate finishes, and extensive landscaping will extend the duration. We work closely with clients to establish a realistic schedule and provide regular updates on progress.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom luxury home construction typically takes 12-24 months after a 3-6 month design phase, depending on complexity and materials.
